Senior Backend Engineer

We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to build scalable APIs and distributed systems. You will design REST APIs, optimize database performance, and improve reliability.

Responsibilities
- Build and maintain microservices using Python and FastAPI.
- Design REST APIs backed by MySQL and Redis.
- Use Docker for packaging and deployments on AWS.
- Lead debugging and performance optimization efforts.

Required Skills
Python, FastAPI, MySQL, Redis, Docker, AWS, Testing, System Design

Minimum Experience
4 years

Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field.
